punchline: Claiming he was sane counted as a symptom, not as proof.
thirty_sec: To avoid a seven-year sentence, Tony says, he faked madness and was sent to Broadmoor, where Hare's checklist classified him as a psychopath. Its head clinician called the faking itself deceitful and manipulative, so every denial confirmed the label.
question: Which opinion of someone are you protecting without being able to name what would change it?
key_contrast: A verdict that every answer confirms has stopped listening.
